query: Which playwright lived a longer life, Edward Albee or J. M. Barrie?

pipeline_result.response:
To determine which playwright lived a longer life, I need to compare the lifespans of Edward Albee and J.M. Barrie.

Edward Albee (1928-2003)
J.M. Barrie (1909-1989)

Edward Albee was born in 1928 and passed away in 2003, which means he lived for approximately 75 years.
J.M. Barrie was born in 1909 and died in 1989, giving him a life span of around 80 years.

Based on this information, J.M. Barrie lived longer than Edward Albee.
